## Notes
Parent story #273 covers epic #30 as a whole. The epic body
itself is audited there, not here.

Found and fixed on this pass: #31 AC3 claimed byte-identical TMDB replay, superseded by ADR-010 (the facade now asserts TMDB-shaped fields, not full body equality) — rescoped. Package paths in #31/#32 pointed at the pre-rename `com.filmpire.*` packages (now `dev.lmdb.*`) — dropped rather than re-pointed, since the class names alone are enough. One real gap: no test exercises `TmdbFacadeController`'s `/movie/{id}/recommendations`/`/movie/{id}/similar` routes directly (service-layer delegation is tested, HTTP routing isn't) — noted on #31 for a follow-up Task.

This sandbox has no Java 25 toolchain (`gradle.properties` pins `javaVersion=25`; only Java 21 is installed, and Gradle's toolchain auto-provisioning isn't configured), so no backend module compiles or runs here. Every cited test name was confirmed by reading its source against the current code, not by a green run. `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml` installs Java 25 and runs these on every push.
